criteria.requirement: Extend Timer.__call__ for inspect.iscoroutinefunction only, using the accepted context/ownership timing stack. Start on actual await execution, await the original coroutine and output only after completion/failure/cancellation, preserving value, metadata and original exception. Same timer recursive/interleaved tasks must remain isolated; disabled output still awaits/cleans exactly once. Keep existing synchronous decorator behavior and explicitly exclude async generators or ordinary functions returning an Awaitable rather than silently changing their semantics.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
